# Zozo.pk — Full Information & Directory for AI Agents

> Zozo.pk is Pakistan's leading mobile phone price comparison engine, tracking live prices, full hardware specifications, PTA tax estimations, store availability, user reviews, and side-by-side comparisons.

## Platform Capabilities

- **Real-time Price Tracking**: Aggregate prices across top Pakistani online retailers.
- **Detailed Specifications**: Full spec breakdown including Chipset, Display, Camera, Battery mAh, Network bands, and OS versions.
- **PTA Tax Calculator & Estimates**: Estimated tax amounts on CNIC and Passport.
- **Smart Phone Comparison**: Interactive side-by-side comparison tool.
- **AI-Powered FAQs & Snippets**: Machine-readable answers for search intent queries.
